verdict.rationale: Brex's own marketing claims 'AI-powered automation of invoice entry, approval, and payments' with automated GL coding (brex-docs-7, brex-docs-8), directly matching the bill-reading/auto-populate story. However, community evidence raises serious doubts about Brex's production AI reliability (hallucination concerns, incorrect outputs) and suggests Brex lagged behind competitors like Ramp on AI capabilities, casting doubt on how mature this feature actually is.
